pages.text: $(italic)No tradeoffs. No standout strengths. The Human is the most flexible race — every class and playstyle is equally viable.$(/italic)$(br2)$(bold)Racial Traits:$(/bold)$(br2)$(bold)Versatile$(/bold) — Gain +1 bonus to whichever skill tree you invest in most (evaluated every 30 min). Rewards focused builds.$(br2)$(bold)Quick Learner$(/bold) — +15% XP gained from all sources. Compounds significantly over long play sessions.$(br2)$(bold)Adaptable$(/bold) — Can change secondary race trait every 24 IRL hours via $(thing)Class Altar$(/thing) (minor toggle only).
